title: introduce-sealedsecret-snapshot-rotator-with-transit-rekey-and-helm-upgrade-hooks
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add sealedsecret snapshot/rotation automation with optional transit rekey; Helm upgrade hooks to ensure backups before upgrade; Terraform module updates for KMS binding and RBAC; no user-facing API changes.
description: Context and motivation: Private deployments need an auditable, rollback-safe way to rotate secrets and keep recoverable backups of SealedSecrets when performing upgrades or rekey operations. Existing sealedsecret workflows at customers relied on ad-hoc scripts that are error-prone during multi-cluster upgrades and HSM/KMS key rotations. This PR introduces a controller and operational tooling that: 1) periodically snapshots SealedSecrets into a versioned encrypted archive, 2) stores snapshots in a user-configurable backend (S3-compatible or internal object store) encrypted with a transit KMS (Vault/AWS KMS) envelope, and 3) supports staged rekey/promotion with a safe rollback path. The design emphasizes minimal blast radius: snapshots are immutable objects with metadata linking to the KMS key version that encrypted them. Highlights and checklist: - New controller: sealedsecret-snapshot-rotator (daemonset-compatible, leader-elected) - Helm values: .sealedSnapshot.enabled, .sealedSnapshot.retention, .sealedSnapshot.backend, .sealedSnapshot.kms.transitKeyPath, .sealedSnapshot.preUpgrade.hookEnabled - Terraform: add module redwood_sealedsnapshot_kms_binding to create IAM/policies or Vault roles and bind them to installer service account - Upgrade hooks: pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade verification hooks added to the Helm chart; hooks are idempotent and safe to re-run - Rekey workflow: a two-phase re-encrypt step that creates new snapshots with the new key while leaving previous snapshots intact; an emergency rollback command is provided to re-decrypt with prior key when necessary - Auditability: controller emits events and metrics; snapshots include manifest with resource names, namespace, SealedSecret controller version, and KMS key ID - Tests: e2e upgrade test that verifies snapshot + restore across chart version bump; unit tests for rekey logic - Docs: README and Upgrade playbook explaining operational steps and recovery procedures Checklist: [x] Controller implementation and unit tests [x] Helm chart changes + migration hooks [x] Terraform module for KMS binding and example usage [x] e2e test for upgrade + restore [x] Docs and runbook added What changed (high level commits): - implement snapshot rotator controller and reconciliation loop - add encrypt/decrypt using Vault transit and AWS KMS envelope support - add Helm chart templates for Job hooks and CronJob/DaemonSet config - add Terraform module and examples for IAM/Vault role bindings - e2e tests and CI workflow updates - docs: upgrade playbook, operator config reference Backwards compatibility notes: Controller is opt-in via Helm values (.sealedSnapshot.enabled=false by default). Existing SealedSecrets remain unchanged unless operator is enabled. Rekey operations require explicit CLI/workflow initiation by cluster operators to avoid accidental mass re-encryption. Security considerations: snapshots are encrypted with customer-provided transit key; we added KMS key ID binding in snapshot metadata and require RBAC to restrict snapshot read operations. Rollback safety ensures previous encrypted snapshots are kept until explicitly pruned. Related work: builds on ENG-2903 (sealedsecret lifecycle improvements) and incident notes from SUP-1289.

+++ helm/redwood-private-installer/templates/preupgrade-backup-hook.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: sealedsnapshot-preupgrade-{{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
      containers:
      - name: backup
        image: {{ .Values.sealedSnapshot.image }}
        args: ["backup", "--destination={{ .Values.sealedSnapshot.backend }}"]
      restartPolicy: Never

Deployment: Helm chart bump + one-time migration job (pre-upgrade hook) required for clusters enabling the feature.
operational_notes: To enable: set helm value sealedSnapshot.enabled=true and configure sealedSnapshot.kms.transitKeyPath and backend settings.
Pre-upgrade hook runs as Job; operators can set .sealedSnapshot.preUpgrade.timeoutSeconds to control window.
Snapshot retention defaults to 30 days; adjustable via .sealedSnapshot.retention and prune script (scripts/prune_snapshots.sh).
Rekey procedure: run `rotator rekey start --new-key=<path>` from operator CLI; monitor metrics sealedsnapshot_reencrypt_in_progress and sealedsnapshot_reencrypt_failed.
Rollback: `rotator rekey rollback --to-key-version=<old>` will re-emit events and make older snapshots active for restore; snapshots are kept until pruned.
Terraform: see terraform/modules/sealedsnapshot_kms_binding/README for IAM/Vault role binding examples; apply before enabling Helm chart to grant write permissions.
